# Table fixture

Markdown tables must show every body row under the header.

| Who's asking | Business question | Why the current system struggles |
|---|---|---|
| Sales / RevOps | Find 20 accounts that look like our 3 best customers but are not in our pipeline yet. | Looks like is not a column in the CRM. |
| Customer Success | Which customers are quietly unhappy? | The signal may be usage decline, sentiment, unresolved friction, and contract timing. |
| Field Service | Dispatch the right tech to this site by 4pm. | The answer depends on skill, availability, drive time, parts, priority, and territory. |
